item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.
item.content:encoded:
Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

item.title: Trump's Affordable Suit
item.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with New York Times fashion reporter Jacob Gallagher about President Trump's apparent choice to wear a suit from the budget menswear chain Jos. A. Bank.

item.title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
item.description: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

item.title: Republican congressman tries to outrun a potential blue wave in New York toss-up seat
item.description: Rep. Mike Lawler, R-NY, is in a tight race for re-election in a toss-up district that could help determine control of Congress in November.

item.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
item.description: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.

item.title: 25 years later an Afghan couple looks back at the invasion
item.description: Twenty-five years ago this week, the U.S. invaded Afghanistan. For StoryCorps, one Afghan couple offers an account of their experience after the invasion and eventual U.S. withdrawal.

item.title: Trump's War in Iran in spotlight ahead of midterms
item.description: After President Trump slapped down reports that he is considered renewed strikes against Iran ahead of the midterms, the politics of the war he started are in the spotlight.

item.title: A congressman wants his House colleagues to pledge to accept election results
item.description: Rep. Josh Gottheimer, D-N.J., is co-leading an effort to get colleagues to pledge they'll accept this fall's election results and oppose any effort to block the seating of fellow members next year.

item.title: White House correspondent April Ryan reflects on reporting while under attack
item.description: Ryan has spent decades pressing presidents for answers. She talks about access, power, race and how asking questions put her in President Trump's crosshairs. Her new book is Notes on a Blacklash.
